decision_rule: mixed iff calibrated P(mixed) >= t_mixed, else argmax of P(human), P(ai). t_mixed tuned on a held-out validation split carved from TRAIN.

calibration.js_note: After computing doc logits z[k] (classes order as in doc_model.classes), apply the per-class affine transform z[k] = w[k]*z[k] + b[k] BEFORE softmax, then softmax. The mixed threshold rule applies to the calibrated P(mixed).

sentence_model.note: word and char blocks are each L2-normalized separately, then concatenated [word | char]; coef aligns to that order. UNCHANGED from v13 (sentence head frozen).

notes: Sentence P(AI) feeds the 11 aggregate features. Doc logits -> CALIBRATION transform (see calibration object) -> softmax; the mixed threshold rule applies to calibrated probabilities. Doc model retrained on 85% of the V13 training pool (title-grouped fit/val) with stratified AI pool (all neural-paraphrase docs kept, HuGPT AI 250 GPT-5 + 250 GPT-4o) to target mixed recall, GPT-5 and neural-paraphrase detection; sentence head identical to v13. t_mixed=0.20 on the calibrated scale.
